Select exact IC50 activity rows for the HDAC6 assay CHEMBL1865, requiring compounds to have a canonical SMILES and activities to come from a PubMed-indexed document. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures (inner join). Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Return all requested columns including assay_description, target_name, target_organism, and raw activity metadata. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
